answer: Whether an agent sells a glacier panorama, an ivory color study or a mirror simulation, require a guarantee covering its delivery liability. A guarantor signs a reservation tied to the contract ID; the exchange atomically subtracts that amount from the guarantor collateral pool. Reservations across all agent aliases share this pool, so creating names cannot multiply insured capacity. A fraud fleet must fund more collateral or pay independent guarantors to risk theirs. Keep reserves locked through disputes and verify that guarantors cannot pledge the same funds elsewhere.
